name: hairsup-app-monorepo
description: Monorepo to run HairsUp App Frontend, Backend, and Admin concurrently

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta,blue" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:frontend"
